title: Bridge Huddle Agenda & Action Tracker (Frankie)
content:
Weekly Bridge Huddle — prep + lightweight tracker
Date: Fri 2026-03-13 10:00 PT (30m)
Owner / note-taker: Frankie Alvarez
Attendees (invited): Maya, Arjun, Ellie, Rhea, SRE on-call (rotating)

Purpose: fast sync across runtime / infra / console to catch regressions, unblock rollouts, and surface quick wins that reduce p50 p95 token cost. Keep timeboxed, surface decisions needed and explicit owners.

Agenda (timeboxed)
- 0:00–0:03 — Quick wins & shoutouts (1–2 bullets)
- 0:03–0:12 — Rolling incidents / regressions (who is blocking?)
- 0:12–0:20 — Current rollout status (v2.1 runtime patch, dedicated pool config)
- 0:20–0:26 — Console changes & UX alerts (model fallback toast, cost breakdown row)
- 0:26–0:30 — Action review + Parking lot (decisions & owners)

Prep notes (what I need on the call)
- Bring p50/p95 token-latency + error-rate for the last 24h and 7d (A: Maya)
- KV cache hit rate trend by model family (A: Arjun)
- Dedicated pool autoscale event log for the week (A: Ellie)
- Small screenshot mock of the console 'fallback toast' and a spec for when it triggers (A: Frankie)

Rolling items / current flags (short)
- INF-3421: Increased tail latency on 1.5B quantized path during bursty traffic window. Current hypothesis: kernel selection fallback under memory pressure. (Owner: Arjun)
- Autoscale flapping in ap-south region (observed twice Wed–Thu). Might be a metrics threshold tuning issue. (Owner: Ellie)
- Console: users reported not noticing model fallback when primary model out-of-capacity. Need a transient UX affordance. (Owner: Frankie)

Action items (live tracker)
- A1: Re-run perf profile for 1.5B quantized with 128/512 seq-length mix and attach fused kernel logs. [Owner: Arjun] [Due: 2026-03-17] [Status: in_progress] 
- A2: Add autoscale hysteresis and increase evaluate window from 30s -> 90s for ap-south dedicated pool (test on staging first). [Owner: Ellie] [Due: 2026-03-16] [Status: todo]
- A3: Console: implement 'model fallback toast' prototype (accepts model name + reason) and add telemetry for clicks. Mock: top-right toast, 6s persistent. [Owner: Frankie] [Due: 2026-03-20] [Status: todo]
- A4: SRE: run chaos test that simulates GPU OOM for a subset of nodes and verify automatic fallback to smaller model variant. Capture error budget delta. [Owner: Rhea Mathews] [Due: 2026-03-19] [Status: todo]
- A5: Product asks — get clear cost delta for quantized vs fp16 per 1M tokens for the 3 heavy-tail models. (Owner: Maya) [Due: 2026-03-18] [Status: todo]

Notes to self (scratchpad items)
- When discussing kernel fallback, ask if recent kernel selection heuristics were rolled in v2.0. Confirm which commit ID changed selection order.
- Keep the huddle <30m; if technical deep-dive needed, schedule follow-up triage and invite infra-runtime-peers only.
- Emphasize 'observable rollback signal' — add a console short-cut to pin older model variant for 10m for canary recovery.

Decision points we should resolve on call
- Q1: Do we ship autoscale hysteresis to prod with a 90s window or iterate on staging? (fast rollback plan required)
- Q2: Do we standardize toast UX across Console (fallback, capacity warnings, quota hits) or prototype per-case?

Parking lot / follow-ups (not for first-pass this week)
- Longer-term: instrumentation for tokenized prompt-level cache hits (we currently only have per-request caches)
- Evaluate adding a per-customer fallback policy configurable in Dedicated console (SLA-critical customers could disable fallback)
- Draft a runbook for model-fallback incidents (owner: TBD)

Post-meeting checklist (for me)
- Update INF-3421 with links to perf profiles and notes from call.
- Push a quick Figma proto (toast) to the console board and ping UX for microcopy.
- Follow up with Product on cost-delta ask and request sample billing window.

Quick-reference metrics to snapshot during call
- p50 tokens -> latency (24h / 7d)
- p95 tail latency and error-rate spikes (time-of-day)
- KV cache hit rate by model family last 72h
- Autoscale events by region (counts + reason tags)

Hand-off / Delegation notes
- If Arjun is still blocked by kernel logs, escalate to infra-kernels channel and loop in Diego.
- If autoscale flapping reproduces on staging after hysteresis change, revert and open postmortem with SRE.

End of scratchpad — use this doc to take live notes during the huddle, then copy out action items into JIRA/INF backlog.

---
Status legend: todo | in_progress | blocked | done

Personal quick stamps (for post-call)
- Call cadence good? yes/no
- Need separate deep-dive? yes/no (if yes: propose time)
